name: Glycidyl neodecanoate
description: Glycidyl neodecanoate (CAS 26761-45-5 ), commercially known as Glydexx N-10, is a reactive epoxy monomer used to modify resin systems and polymer networks. It functions as a reactive diluent in epoxy formulations, reducing viscosity while participating in the cure reaction. In epoxy coatings for automotive and aerospace substrates, it lowers system viscosity to improve application properties without sacrificing crosslink density. This allows for better flow and leveling during the coating process. Adhesive and sealant formulators incorporate it to enhance flexibility and adhesion to low-energy surfaces. This is particularly useful where long-term durability under mechanical stress is required for industrial applications. In printing inks and packaging coatings, it supports surface wetting and film formation on difficult substrates. This ensures a high-quality finish and consistent performance across various types of packaging materials. Polymer manufacturers also use it as a reactive building block to introduce pendant epoxy functionality into specialty resins and elastomers. This versatility makes it a staple in advanced chemical manufacturing. Glycidyl neodecanoate is supplied as a clear liquid in drum and IBC quantities. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering, with purity specifications typically confirmed by epoxide equivalent weight and GC assay. It is handled and stored under conditions appropriate for reactive epoxy monomers to preserve shelf life and reactivity.
